claims.head: Carolina’s shot volume meets a soft spot
claims.body: Carolina ranks 3rd of 32 for shot volume (65.8 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5); Philadelphia ranks 30th for shot suppression.

claims.head: Philadelphia pounces on mistakes, and Carolina makes them
claims.body: Philadelphia ranks 7th of 32 for chances off turnovers (7.7% of its chances come right after winning the puck); Carolina ranks 24th for avoiding breakdowns.

claims.head: Two of the league’s heaviest-hitting teams
claims.body: Carolina’s hit score is 116 (5th of 32) and Philadelphia’s is 111 (8th). 100 is league average, after adjusting for each arena’s scorer.
